name: El Nido Airport
before:
A small airstrip serving El Nido in Palawan, about 4 km from the town proper in the barangay of Villa Libertad.

The ownership is unusual and worth knowing. The airport is owned and operated by Cebu Pacific rather than by a public authority, so the schedule is effectively one airline's decision. Check what is flying before promising a client a date.

It is also known as Lio Airport, so both names appear in supplier systems.

There is a single concrete airstrip. An older gravel runway is now partly surfaced and used as a taxiway.
